question: Should this issue remain open for a clarification request about the possible Freestyle-provider intent, or be manually closed as accidental or unintelligible content?
rationale: The title loosely matches a real provider, but neither the body nor attachment identifies author intent or a repository behavior that automation can safely implement or close.

options.title: Request clarification
options.body: Keep it open briefly and ask for the exact command, expected and actual behavior, version, redacted configuration, and readable diagnostics.

options.title: Close manually
options.body: Close it as accidental or unintelligible content if maintainers do not want to retain a clarification window.

recommendation.title: Request clarification
recommendation.body: Keep it open briefly and ask for the exact command, expected and actual behavior, version, redacted configuration, and readable diagnostics.
